chunks: "When the deceased dies in the sea, he is given ghusl, hunut is applied, and he is shrouded. Then a stone is fastened to his leg, and he is cast into the water."

key_terms.الْبَحْرِ: the sea, the place where the death occurs
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: the water into which the body is cast
key_terms.حَجَرٌ: a stone tied to the body
key_terms.غُسِّلَ: was washed with the funerary ghusl

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased person be treated if they die at sea according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for handling the body of a deceased person when death occurs at sea. It states that the deceased should still receive the prescribed funerary rites of ghusl, hunut, and shrouding before being consigned to the water with a stone tied to the leg.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.438 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"When a person dies at sea, they are washed, anointed (with Hunut), and shrouded. Then a stone should be tied to their leg, and they should be cast into the water."
